formula: SESS_OPEXDAY_INTRADAY (short SPY open->close on the monthly OPEX session)
reading: Not a clean decay and not a clean constant: the effect is strong in four consecutive design blocks 1993-2012 (+11 to +17bp per OPEX session), FLAT in 2013-2016 (+1.1bp), strong again in the 2017-2021 holdout block (+19.1bp), and FLAT again in 2022-2026 (+1.5bp). It is intermittent, and it is dormant in the most recent 4.5 years. That pattern is compatible with a real but regime-dependent expiry effect AND with an unstable statistic; 116 held-out observations cannot separate the two.
